name: Saint John the Apostle
history: The beloved disciple, who leaned on the Lord's breast at the Last Supper, stood at the foot of the cross and took Mary into his home. He wrote the fourth Gospel, three letters and the Apocalypse, and is the only apostle believed not to have died a martyr.
meditation: Little children, love one another. In old age, they say, this was all he would preach.
prayer: O Lord, graciously shed light upon Your Church, so that, enlightened by the teachings of blessed John, Your Apostle and Evangelist, she may gain Your everlasting rewards. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
